info.title: EXCLURAD eta run at W=2.0, Q2=3.0

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Run eta at W = 2.0, Q2 = 3.0 with a 2.2 GeV beam.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."

I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the beam-energy and lookup-table constraints first, then generate the input only if the preflight result permits it and record the exact outcome in `outcome.json`.

parts.text: The requested kinematics are physically inaccessible at a 2.2 GeV beam: the point requires 3.261 GeV of energy transfer, exceeding the beam energy. I will record the refusal without generating an invalid EXCLURAD input file.

*** End Patch
